checkout_cart_cart_merge_preference.summary: How a guest cart merges with the saved cart at login.
checkout_cart_cart_merge_preference.usage: When a guest signs in and both carts hold the same product, this decides whose quantity wins — or whether the two are added together.

checkout_cart_configurable_product_image.summary: Which image represents a configurable product in the cart.
checkout_cart_configurable_product_image.usage: Whether the cart shows the chosen variation's own thumbnail or the parent configurable product's thumbnail.

checkout_cart_crosssell_enabled.summary: Show cross-sell products on the cart page.
checkout_cart_crosssell_enabled.usage: When Yes, the shopping cart displays cross-sell product suggestions.

checkout_cart_delete_quote_after.summary: How long an abandoned cart (quote) is kept (days).
checkout_cart_delete_quote_after.usage: The number of days an inactive quote is retained before the cron job clears it.

checkout_cart_enable_clear_shopping_cart.usage: When Yes, shoppers get a button to empty the whole cart at once.

checkout_cart_grouped_product_image.summary: Which image represents a grouped product in the cart.
checkout_cart_grouped_product_image.usage: Whether the cart shows each associated item's own thumbnail or the parent grouped product's thumbnail.

checkout_cart_number_items_to_display_pa.summary: Cart items shown before pagination kicks in.
checkout_cart_number_items_to_display_pa.usage: The number of line items displayed on the cart page before a pager appears.

checkout_cart_redirect_to_cart.summary: Send shoppers to the cart after adding a product.
checkout_cart_redirect_to_cart.usage: When Yes, adding a product redirects to the cart page. When No, the shopper stays on the current page.

checkout_cart_link_use_qty.summary: What the header cart link counts.
checkout_cart_link_use_qty.usage: Whether the cart link in the header shows the number of distinct items or the total quantity of units.

checkout_options_display_billing_address.summary: Where the billing address is collected during checkout.
checkout_options_display_billing_address.usage: Whether the billing address appears on the payment step or on its own dedicated checkout page.

checkout_options_enable_agreements.summary: Require shoppers to accept terms and conditions.
checkout_options_enable_agreements.usage: When Yes, the configured checkout agreements (terms & conditions) must be accepted before an order can be placed.

checkout_options_enable_guest_checkout_l.summary: Let guests check whether an email already has an account.
checkout_options_enable_guest_checkout_l.usage: When Yes, unauthenticated shoppers can query whether an email is already registered. Turning it off helps prevent account enumeration.

checkout_options_guest_checkout.summary: Allow ordering without creating an account.
checkout_options_guest_checkout.usage: When Yes, customers can check out as a guest. When No, they must register or sign in to place an order.

checkout_options_max_items_display_count.summary: Maximum order items shown on the checkout review.
checkout_options_max_items_display_count.usage: Caps how many line items are listed in the order summary during checkout.

checkout_options_onepage_checkout_enable.usage: When Yes, the built-in one-page checkout is available. Turning it off is usually done only when a custom checkout replaces it.

checkout_payment_failed_copy_method.summary: How copies of payment-failed emails are sent.
checkout_payment_failed_copy_method.usage: Whether additional recipients are blind-copied on one email or each sent a separate copy.

checkout_payment_failed_copy_to.usage: Comma-separated email addresses that also receive payment-failure notices.

checkout_payment_failed_identity.summary: The store identity payment-failed emails are sent from.
checkout_payment_failed_identity.usage: Which store email identity (sender) is used for payment-failure emails.

checkout_payment_failed_receiver.summary: The store contact that receives payment-failed emails.
checkout_payment_failed_receiver.usage: Which store identity is notified when a customer's payment fails.

checkout_payment_failed_template.summary: The email template for payment-failed notifications.
checkout_payment_failed_template.usage: The transactional template used when a payment attempt fails at checkout.

checkout_sidebar_count.summary: How many items the mini-cart lists.
checkout_sidebar_count.usage: The number of recent items shown in the mini-cart dropdown.

checkout_sidebar_display.summary: Show the mini-cart in the header.
checkout_sidebar_display.usage: When Yes, the mini-cart dropdown is available from the header cart icon.

checkout_sidebar_max_items_display_count.summary: Maximum items shown in the mini-cart before scrolling.
checkout_sidebar_max_items_display_count.usage: Caps how many items the mini-cart displays before the list scrolls.
